correctness.rationale: For every probability triple, direct expansion gives M2=sum_{i,j} p_i p_j W_i W_j W_i on mean-zero states. Reflection averaging is exactly M2(sym)+d^2 C with C positive semidefinite. The positive, unequal odd top-eigenvector has positive C-quadratic form, forcing symmetry. Its exact 2x2 block has top eigenvalue F(b), which strictly dominates the even block. At every stationary b, a fixed positive top-eigenvector supports a strictly convex Rayleigh quadratic tangent to F; therefore any stationary point is the unique global minimum. Endpoint derivatives and an exact isolating interval establish existence and uniqueness. The one-step unique optimizer, the four-path disagreement and the two-/three-vertex minimality are independently derived. verify.py checks the symbolic matrices and 300 supplementary randomized values; those samples are not used to justify universal quantifiers.

value.rationale: Finite-horizon mean-square error is a natural exact performance objective for gossip and contrasts sharply with the optimizable one-round eigenvalue surrogate. The path of four vertices is proved minimal for distinct optimal laws, with all probability triples considered, algebraic expressions for both unique policies, and a generalizable reflection-symmetrization plus tangent-Rayleigh certificate for a nonconvex finite product. The gain is quantitatively small, so the scientific value resides in the rigorous minimal counterexample and design boundary, not a large engineering improvement.
